 Thunder vs. Clippers injury report: Ajay Mitchell’s status for NBA Cup after missing Blazers game
 After missing their last game against the Blazers, Ajay Mitchell is once again listed on the Thunder vs. Clippers NBA Cup injury report.
 By Brad Taningco • Nov 13, 2026 at 9:33 AM ET • 2 min read Add ClutchPoints on Google Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images The Oklahoma City Thunder will clash with the LA Clippers after back-to-back defeats to the Portland Trail Blazers . The Thunder were without Ajay Mitchell for the second of those two games, and he's once again listed as questionable on the official injury report due to a left ankle sprain.
 Here's everything we know about Ajay Mitchell's injury and his playing status vs. the Clippers.
 Watch NBA games LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Ajay Mitchell's injury status vs. Clippers
 Mitchell is listed as questionable to play after missing the Thunder's last game against the Blazers. While Alex Caruso scored 14 points starting in place of Mitchell, OKC still missed Mitchell's offensive talents against Portland's tough perimeter defense.
 With Jalen Williams out due to a serious ankle injury, Mitchell has stepped up as the Thunder's secondary scorer behind Shai Gilgeous-Alexander . In eight games as a starter, Mitchell is averaging 21 points while shooting a blistering 54% from the field.
 The extra day of rest has likely helped Mitchell recover from his ankle sprain. So when it comes to the question of whether Ajay Mitchell is playing vs. the Clippers, the answer is possibly.
